title: Negative Balance
story: A ledger has turned a refund into a charge, and Hal needs the sign restored before the nightly run. In a small side room the player restores the minus with the held-Space layer and learns that N and M stay letters inside values. Once the refund reads as a refund, Hal sits on his stool and Mira offers Payroll Run at the nearby chute.

steps.objective: Talk to Hal at the routing machine about the ledger.
Walk to the refund ledger in the south-west room.
Make the refund negative, then type the reference codes with n and m kept as letters.
Correct the third invoice without hints.
Visit Mira at the chute; she offers Payroll Run.
Optional: repair the folded refund slip.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Invoice 1, the refund: make the refund value negative with the minus on the held-Space layer, then write a short range with the same key.
success_criteria: Coverage for S11 credited by output observed; the UI says output observed, not that a Space hold was proved

feedback.wrong_character: Observed {observed}; the sign must be a minus (-). Hold Space and press the apostrophe key.
feedback.apostrophe: Observed an apostrophe: Space was not held. The minus is Space + the apostrophe key.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Invoice 1, the reference codes: type net-30, then 3n8 and 9m1. N and M stay literal letters on numbers-symbols; they do not become digits or edits.

a backspace or other edit in place of n or m

dialogue.text: A ledger turned a refund into a charge, and the nightly run is close. Can you restore the minus sign in the ledger room, south-west of the hub?

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Journal: refund 85 posted as a charge. Fix the sign, then check that n and m stay letters inside values.

dialogue.text: Second invoice. The figures changed, and the minus is still the minus.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: The refund reads as a refund again, and the warning light is steady. I can sit down for this one.
dialogue.cue: Hal neutral: the end of 13, when Hal sits instead of crouching

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Payroll Run: carry changing IDs and signed amounts from the chute to three desks. Learn the loop first; your first clean run is just a baseline.

then.text: Hal went ahead to the ledger room, south-west of the hub.
Refund sign restored. Mira offers Payroll Run at the chute.
The folded refund slip is flat and ordinary again.

state_changes.before: The ledger display shows the refund as a charge in orange, the machine's warning light pulses wide, and Hal crouches beside a folded stool.
state_changes.after: The ledger shows a green refund, the warning light is steady, the stool is open with Hal seated on it, and the ledger room lamp is on.

visible_changes.note: crouched repair to seated on the stool (proxy animation until drawn)

glitch.note: Harmless paper-fold glitch; optional untimed repair with immediate retry.
